issuer: the Ministry of Transport and Communications, as the licensing authority

licence.name: driving licence, grade B (private vehicles to seven seats)

note: Council of Ministers Decision No. 2 of 2009, amending the executive regulation (of 13 September 2005) of Traffic Law No. 5 of 2000, as held by Maqam, An-Najah University's legislation database, read again 2026-10-31 (the PDF's text is in Arabic presentation forms, quoted as extracted): art. 3, replacing art. 121, issues a grade B licence (art. 2: private vehicles of up to seven seats besides the driver) to one who has completed seventeen and a half years of age, held as 17 years and 6 months, the decision's own words. No later amendment of art. 121 was found (palestinecabinet.gov.ps and mot.gov.ps gave no answer over https on 2026-10-31, and mot.gov.ps over http answered 503), so that it still holds is not proven past the 2009 text. Whether a first licence is a probationary one, its term and its fee aren't in the decision, so the term and fee are null. Until 2026-10-31 Palestine stood blocked because the age falls between birthdays.
